modules.title: 1 · Unit roots and spurious regression
modules.summary: Distinguish persistent stochastic trends from stable relationships.

stages.title: Unit roots and spurious regression: research guide
stages.html:
Unit roots and spurious regression

Distinguish persistent stochastic trends from stable relationships.

Unrelated integrated series can produce impressive t statistics and R-squared; residual persistence reveals the spurious fit.

Workflow. Specify deterministic terms and interpret tests with their low-power limitations.

Diagnostic: Inspect trend specification, lag length, and complementary evidence. The main failure to avoid is classifying persistence from one test statistic alone.

stages.title: Unit-root testing intuition lab
stages.note: Move the control and explain the shape before running Python. Focus on trend specification, lag length, and complementary evidence.
stages.insight: Unrelated integrated series can produce impressive t statistics and R-squared; residual persistence reveals the spurious fit.

stages.title: Unit roots and spurious regression: worked Python model
stages.note: Run the reproducible example, then change one assumption and compare the output.
stages.code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
phi = 0.72
y = np.zeros(160)
for t in range(1, len(y)):
    y[t] = phi*y[t-1] + rng.normal(scale=0.8)
X, target = y[:-1, None], y[1:]
phi_hat = np.linalg.lstsq(X, target, rcond=None)[0][0]
forecast = phi_hat*y[-1]
print(f"Estimated persistence: {phi_hat:.3f}")
print(f"One-step forecast: {forecast:.3f}")

modules.title: 2 · Engle-Granger cointegration
modules.summary: Test whether a linear combination of integrated variables is stationary.

stages.title: Engle-Granger cointegration: research guide
stages.html:
Engle-Granger cointegration

Test whether a linear combination of integrated variables is stationary.

Residual-based critical values differ from ordinary unit-root tests because the long-run relation is estimated first.

Workflow. Estimate a long-run relation and test whether its residual is stationary with correct critical values.

Diagnostic: Inspect residual-based unit-root evidence and normalization. The main failure to avoid is using ordinary unit-root critical values on estimated residuals.

modules.title: 3 · Johansen systems and rank
modules.summary: Determine how many stationary long-run relations a multivariate system contains.

stages.title: Johansen systems and rank: research guide
stages.html:
Johansen systems and rank

Determine how many stationary long-run relations a multivariate system contains.

Rank tests depend on deterministic terms and lag order; normalization then gives interpretable cointegrating vectors.

Workflow. Determine cointegration rank in a system before interpreting vectors.

Diagnostic: Inspect deterministic specification, lag order, trace and maximum-eigenvalue tests. The main failure to avoid is selecting a rank without matching the system specification.

stages.title: Johansen rank analysis intuition lab
stages.note: Move the control and explain the shape before running Python. Focus on deterministic specification, lag order, trace and maximum-eigenvalue tests.
stages.insight: Rank tests depend on deterministic terms and lag order; normalization then gives interpretable cointegrating vectors.

stages.title: Johansen systems and rank: worked Python model
stages.note: Run the reproducible example, then change one assumption and compare the output.
stages.code:
prior_mean, prior_var = 1.2, 0.9
measurement, measurement_var = 2.0, 0.4
gain = prior_var / (prior_var + measurement_var)
posterior_mean = prior_mean + gain*(measurement-prior_mean)
posterior_var = (1-gain)*prior_var
print(f"Kalman gain: {gain:.3f}")
print(f"Posterior state: {posterior_mean:.3f}")
print(f"Posterior variance: {posterior_var:.3f}")

stages.note: Complete the scalar Kalman update by calculating gain and posterior_mean.
stages.starter:

measurement, measurement_var = 1.4, 0.25

stages.tests:

expected_mean = prior_mean+expected_gain*(measurement-prior_mean)
assert abs(gain-expected_gain) < 1e-10
assert abs(posterior_mean-expected_mean) < 1e-10
print("grader: Kalman update is correct")
hints: Gain is prior variance divided by total prior-plus-measurement variance.
Update the prior by gain times the measurement innovation.

modules.title: 4 · Vector error correction
modules.summary: Combine short-run changes with adjustment toward long-run equilibrium.

stages.title: Vector error correction: research guide
stages.html:
Vector error correction

Combine short-run changes with adjustment toward long-run equilibrium.

The cointegrating vector defines disequilibrium; adjustment coefficients describe which variables respond to that gap.

Workflow. Combine long-run equilibrium errors with short-run changes.

Diagnostic: Inspect adjustment coefficients, cointegrating vectors, and stability. The main failure to avoid is calling every adjustment coefficient a causal response.

modules.title: 5 · State-space filtering and nowcasting
modules.summary: Estimate latent states and update them as noisy releases arrive.

stages.title: State-space filtering and nowcasting: research guide
stages.html:
State-space filtering and nowcasting

Estimate latent states and update them as noisy releases arrive.

The Kalman filter weighs prior and measurement uncertainty; a real-time nowcast must also respect release dates and data vintages.

Workflow. Update a latent-state estimate by balancing prior and measurement uncertainty.

Diagnostic: Inspect innovation, Kalman gain, and covariance recursion. The main failure to avoid is a state estimate that ignores signal-to-noise information.
